name: Strange World
original_name: ストレンジ・ワールド
source:
Hero is a college student. To earn his living he participates in hospital brainwaves study tests. He dreams of appearing in a castle as a new employee.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-may-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名大学生。为了赚取生活费，他参加了医院的脑电波研究实验。梦中，他来到一座城堡，成为那里的一名新员工。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-may-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
